answer: Give every identity weight only through shale strata that build up slowly: each stratum needs a distinct cipher-signed contribution, checked by unrelated peers, and expires if the identity goes quiet. A whisper check cross-references contributions across the network, so a contribution reused by a clone exposes both copies and burns their strata. An attacker must therefore earn a full, separate stack of verified work for each fake, with no layer transferable between identities, while one honest agent needs only its own stack.
